title: Luxury Townhouse with rooftop view of downtown!
description:
Executive residence in historic Chestnut Hill that is perfect for a small group retreat. $8-10 Lyft ride to the amazing Honky Tonk Highway aka Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, Geodis Soccer Stadium, Ascend amphitheater, Frist art museum, Printer’s Alley and The Gulch. One half mile to the Four Seasons. Only 7 miles (10 minutes) to the airport.

The space
The entire home is available for your group. We have co-op relationships with adjacent units to accommodate larger groups. Up to 50 people. Wedding parties, Corporate groups, Family reunions welcomed.

Guest access
You will have full access to the home including the intimate back patio and private rooftop patio where you can enjoy beautiful sunsets and the Nashville skyline.

Other things to note
Home is furnished by a designer and you will find it to be top notch.
